summary: Implemented the Tabs widget in src/textual/widgets/_tabs.py, with a TabChanged message. It renders a label row above an UnderlineBar and highlights the active tab. Clicking the labels or the underline activates the nearest tab. When focused, left/right cycle with wraparound, digits 1-9 pick a tab by number, and letters cycle through tabs whose labels start with that letter. I also exported Tabs and TabChanged from widgets/__init__.py, added an Unreleased CHANGELOG entry, and added a demo at sandbox/tabs/__main__.py. Nothing was run, per your instructions, and no tests were added. Nothing is committed.
